lines.t: Verse 1
I've never been on my own,
You've been closer than I’ve known.
Every breath I take, every step I move,
You're steady in all I go through.
In the quiet and the noise,
You are my steady voice.
And even when I don't understand,
You always hold out Your hand.
Pre-Chorus
You've been my friend,
You've been my joy.
You've been with through every step.
Chorus
You’re closer than my breath to me,
Closer than I ever see.
Never leaving, never far,
You’re the light inside my dark.
You’re the steady in my wave,
The love that never fades.
I don’t have to search and find—
You’ve been here the whole time.
You’re closer than my breath, closer than my fear,
Your always here.
Verse 2
The world was loud, it pulled at me,
Tried to tell me who to be.
Every voice tried bending what I should choose,
But I stayed grounded in the truth I knew.
When they mocked me, when I cried,
You were always by my side.
When my light started to grow dim,
You helped kindle it again.
In every place I thought I’d fall,
You were steady through it all.
Chorus
You’re closer than my breath to me,
Closer than I ever see.
Never leaving, never far,
You’re the light inside my dark.
You’re the steady in my wave,
The love that never fades.

You’ve been here the whole time.
You’re closer than my breath, closer than my fear,
Your always here.
Bridge
You never changed, You never left…
Even when I had nothing left…
Through every shadow, every fight…
You were still my guiding light…
